name: Lantern Escort
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, Gain 1 Aura.

name: Gate Intercession
rules_text: Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to target responding creature you control this Round. Straighten it.

name: Marshal of the Open Gate
rules_text: Confronting does not cause this creature to Turn. Whenever this creature responds, Gain 2 Aura.

name: Slipstream Scout
rules_text: Airborne (can only be responded to by Airborne creatures or creatures that can respond to Airborne creatures). Whenever this creature deals fighting damage to a player, look at the top card of your deck; you may put it on the bottom.

name: Crosswind Arrest
rules_text: Target confronting creature gets -3/-0 until end of Round.

name: Keeper of the Crossing
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, return up to two target confronting creatures to their owners' hands.

name: Ditch Ambusher
rules_text: When this creature is put into the Pit from play, each opponent loses 1 Aura.

name: Barbed Toll
rules_text: Target confronting creature gets -2/-2 until end of Round. If it is put into the Pit from play this Round, Gain 2 Aura.

name: Warden Below the Bridge
rules_text: Whenever another creature you control is put into the Pit from play, target opponent loses 1 Aura and you Gain 1 Aura.

name: Flintway Runner
rules_text: Can confront and Turn on the Round it comes into play.

name: Splintering Charge
rules_text: Target confronting creature you control gets +3/+0 until end of Round.

name: Cinderlane Captain
rules_text: Whenever this creature confronts, it deals 1 damage to up to one target creature an opponent controls.

name: Briar Reversal
rules_text: Target responding creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of Round.

name: Stoneback Trailbreaker
rules_text: Extra fighting damage beyond a responder's defense hits the responding player.
